title: Solana Policy Institute Asks SEC for Control-Based Ledger Test
why_it_matters: The requested guidance could affect which blockchain architectures tokenized securities venues can use under the SEC exemption, making network governance a compliance design issue rather than only a technical choice.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Solana Policy Institute Asks SEC for Control-Based Ledger Test

The Solana Policy Institute asked the SEC to define permissionless ledgers for tokenized-stock venues through five control and access factors.
